label: SELF_EVIDENT_5: A statement is SELF_EVIDENT_5 in this corpus when its record carries a self_evident…
definition: A statement carries the project self-evident marking when its record has a `self_evident` object with justification ids referring to claims or results. This records a challengeable floor claim, not a Lean proof or an automatic certificate of philosophical warrant. The ordinary bases are retorsion, common_ground and observation; computed closure evaluates their criteria against current records. The runtime also retains documented legacy handling for excluded middle and existing owner_approval records. Those exceptions describe computation, not independent warrant. See docs/corpus-model.md, Premise program and frontier.
note: FIRST_PRINCIPLE_ENTITLEMENT_AND_PRESUPPOSITION_5 is a repository policy sense, currently described in prose and implemented by the frontier computation, with no Lean declaration. It is distinct from classical per se nota; the existing note records no pinned ST I q.2 a.1 passage for that identification. Excluded middle is a concrete legacy example; a conditional retorsion theorem with an open application premise is not by itself an ordinary retorsion floor justification. The marking and the current criterion result are distinct. No marking is added or changed. See docs/notes/psr-self-application-756.md#five-sense-consumer-reconciliation-1659.
